artifacts_content_check.name: artifacts_content_check
artifacts_content_check.value: "artifacts"."content_md" IS NOT NULL OR "artifacts"."uri" IS NOT NULL OR "artifacts"."git_ref" IS NOT NULL

tasks_company_deadline_pidx.name: tasks_company_deadline_pidx

channels_kind_ref_check.name: channels_kind_ref_check
